title: DXF ACAD_TABLE cell-value variant-node admission
mode: local implementation and generated fast verification
scope: Charge each DXF ACAD_TABLE cell's accumulated typed text variant before its first materialization

implementation.change: DRW_Table::parseCode charges the shared DXF typed-variant node budget immediately before the first DRW_CadValue::m_value string variant is materialized for cell text. Subsequent text chunks update that same retained variant without another node charge. Failure propagates through the existing typed-variant ResourceLimit boundary. The installed dxfRW budget comment names the selected ACAD_TABLE route.
